newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-GIANTS GET CUBS' MULHOLLAND ON WAIVERS.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-GIANTS GET CUBS' MULHOLLAND ON WAIVERS.

text.p: The San Francisco Giants, who lead the National League West, claimed left-hander Terry Mulholland off waivers from the Cubs on Friday.
Mulholland, who began his career with the Giants and joins them for the third time, had signed a one-year, $2.3 million free agent deal with the Cubs before the season.
Mulholland, 34, went 6-12 with a 4.07 ERA in 25 starts with one complete game for the Cubs this season.
In 157 innings, he allowed 162 hits -- 20 homers -- and 45 walks with 74 strikeouts.
Last week, the Giants acquired left-hander Wilson Alvarez, and right-handers Roberto Hernandez and Danny Darwin from the White Sox for six minor-leaguers in a trade-deadine deal.
